experiments.question: Do ROM bytes at ROMCPU:$C212F0-$C2141F match the battle.go disassembly claims (dispatch JSR ($131F,X); routines $C21323/$C21350/$C21390; stores $C21338/$C21347/$C21396; table $C2131F)?

starting_state.state: title screen, bridge.lua loaded; ROM reads are state-independent

expected_outcomes: bytes decode to the claimed instructions (supports; upgrade FN-0003..0005 code claims)
bytes contradict any claimed instruction (refutes that claim; open contradiction record)
experiments.falsifying_outcome: bytes at $C21338/$C21347/$C21396 are not 3-byte store instructions, or claimed entry points fall mid-instruction

experiments.question: Does PerFrameBattleUpdate (ROMCPU:$C101FB) execute outside battle?

starting_state.state: title screen; then checkpoint1/2/3 field states; then a random encounter entered by injected walking

expected_outcomes: zero fires in non-battle contexts and ~per-frame fires in battle (supports H-BATTLE-0003)
nonzero fires in a verified non-battle context (refutes)
experiments.falsifying_outcome: nonzero count delta in a verified non-battle context

experiments.question: Is the routine containing the $C25D33-captured store the $3BF4->$2E78 copier, and what does it read?
expected_outcomes: store to $2E78-region at $C25D30 fed from $3BF4-region (supports; chain complete)
experiments.falsifying_outcome: no $2E78-region store at $C25D30, or source is not the $3BF4 family

experiments.question: Do enemy HP values live in entries 4-9 of the unified battle arrays (H-BATTLE-0008)?
